audience: shippers and freight teams that quote, book and document shipments in FreightSimple

useCases.title: Get carrier quotes for a shipment
useCases.text: Start quoting a shipment. Quoting takes about 30 seconds, so read the shipment until its status is Quoted.

useCases.title: Book a quote
useCases.text: Book a quote of a quoted shipment. Booking makes a carrier pickup and commits the cost, so it needs explicit confirmation.

useCases.title: Upload customs documents
useCases.text: Upload base64 PDF files, such as a commercial invoice, to a cross-border shipment. Each upload reaches the carrier at once.

useCases.title: Check shipment status and tracking
useCases.text: Read one shipment by its id or tracking id, with its status, documents and tracking history.

useCases.title: Look up carriers and dangerous goods
useCases.text: List the carriers available to the company, and the dangerous goods entries for a UN number or text.

useCases.title: Maintain saved commodities
useCases.text: List the saved commodities, then create or delete one. Deleting a commodity cannot be undone.
